policy: A compatible reproducible baseline, not a claim of latest versions. Recheck official requirements before upgrades or publishing. Never apply this profile to an existing project automatically.
notes: AGP 8.13.2 supports Kotlin 2.3 and requires Gradle 8.13/JDK 17. AGP 9 uses built-in Kotlin and requires a different template migration.
Compose compiler Gradle plugin uses the Kotlin version; the BOM versions Compose libraries only.
Detekt 1.x uses its own Kotlin compiler. The optional isolated CLI task avoids compiler classpath conflicts; migration of analysis rules to Detekt 2 needs explicit review.
